# Fee proposal: quantity surveying services

Dear committee members,

Thank you for the opportunity to offer our quantity surveying services for the replacement of the
external wall cladding at Tideway Apartments. We understand the owners corporation will fund the work
through special levies, so clear and reliable figures at each general meeting matter as much as the
final account.

Our services and fees are set out below. Every figure in this letter includes GST, so that it can be
compared directly with the special levy.

    Service                                                  Fee (inc GST)
    -------------------------------------------------------  -------------
    Option estimates for the general meeting                      $9,900
    DA cost estimate report (registered quantity surveyor)        $3,300
    Pre-tender estimate                                           $8,800
    Tender assessment and normalisation                           $5,500
    Progress-claim assessment reports                            $22,000
    -------------------------------------------------------  -------------
    Total fee $49,500 including GST

All amounts include GST.

Additional services will be charged at $198 per hour including GST.

The progress-claim assessment reports allow for up to ten monthly reports during construction. Further
reports will be charged at the hourly rate.

We exclude the preparation of a bill of quantities, which we do not consider necessary for a project of
this kind, and any advice on the levy apportionment between lots.

Our offer remains open for 90 days.

Yours faithfully,
